_note: woo-delivered-set-is-a-record REQ-WDS-001 (rows 19.15, 19.16). What dossiq delivered to OpenCatalogi for a Woo decision, as a record of its own: every item with the delivered file's hash, and one hash over the set. Written pending before the publication is created, frozen with the publication id after, deleted when publishing fails. Never published. No authorization block: it is read with the same access as the case, like the assessments it names; there is no public read.

wooDeliveredSet.title: Woo delivered set
wooDeliveredSet.description: What was delivered for publication on a Woo decision: each document as it went out, with the hash of its bytes, and one hash over the whole set. Frozen once the publication exists, so it shows later what went out.

case.title: Case
case.description: The Woo case the set was delivered from.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: The Woo decision the set was delivered with.

status.title: Status
status.description: Pending while the publication is being made, frozen once it exists. A frozen set and the assessments it names cannot be changed.

supersedes.title: Supersedes
supersedes.description: The earlier set of the same case this delivery replaces, if any.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: The publication in OpenCatalogi the set went into. Set when the set is frozen.

withdrawnAt.title: Withdrawn at
withdrawnAt.description: When the publication was withdrawn. The set stays frozen.

setHash.title: Set hash

items.title: Items

assessment.title: Assessment

deliveredRef.title: Delivered file
deliveredRef.description: The document that went out: the original when public in full, the redaction when public in part.

originalRef.title: Original
originalRef.description: The document as it came in.

fileName.title: File name

size.title: Size
size.description: The size of the delivered file in bytes.

sha256.title: SHA-256
sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the delivered file's bytes.
